1	/**
     2	 * GUI API Route Handlers — Repository Registry Domain
     3	 *
     4	 * All REST handlers for the /api/repos and /api/repos/:repoId endpoints.
     5	 * Follows the domain-split pattern established by `api-knowledge.ts` — each
     6	 * API domain gets its own handler file imported from `server.ts`.
     7	 *
     8	 * Routes provided:
     9	 *   GET    /api/repos              — list all declared repositories
    10	 *   GET    /api/repos/:repoId      — get a single repository entry or 404
    11	 *   POST   /api/repos              — create a new repository entry
    12	 *   PUT    /api/repos/:repoId      — update label, folder_names, and/or vision
    13	 *   DELETE /api/repos/:repoId      — remove the declaration (no project data deleted)
    14	 *
    15	 * Validation rules:
    16	 *   - `id` (create): must match SLUG_REGEX; must be unique across existing entries.
    17	 *   - `folder_names`: each name must be unique across ALL entries in the registry.
    18	 *     Create and update operations that would violate this constraint are rejected
    19	 *     with VALIDATION_ERROR (HTTP 400) and a clear error message.
    20	 *   - `label`: non-empty string (min 1 character).
    21	 *   - `vision`: three-horizon object (short_term, mid_term, long_term) — each field
    22	 *     is a nullable string; null means "not yet authored"; empty strings are rejected.
    23	 *
    24	 * Error shape: { code: string, message: string, details?: unknown }
    25	 *   NOT_FOUND        → 404
    26	 *   VALIDATION_ERROR → 400
    27	 *   (unhandled)      → 500
    28	 *
    29	 * STDIO discipline: this file never writes to process.stdout.
    30	 */
    31	
    32	import { z } from 'zod';
    33	import { ApiError } from '../src/gui/errors.js';
    34	import {
    35	  loadRegistry,
    36	  saveRegistry,
    37	} from '../src/storage/repository-registry.js';
    38	import {
    39	  RepositoryEntrySchema,
    40	  StrategicVisionSchema,
    41	  type RepositoryEntry,
    42	} from '../src/schema/repository-registry.js';
    43	import { SLUG_REGEX } from '../src/schema/knowledge.js';
    44	
    45	// Re-export ApiError so consumers can catch typed errors without importing
    46	// from a separate path.
    47	export { ApiError };
    48	
    49	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    50	// Private helpers
    51	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    52	
    53	function validationError(message: string, details?: unknown): never {
    54	  throw new ApiError('VALIDATION_ERROR', message, details);
    55	}
    56	
    57	/**
    58	 * Returns the current ISO 8601 timestamp string.
    59	 */
    60	function nowIso(): string {
    61	  return new Date().toISOString();
    62	}
    63	
    64	/**
    65	 * Validates that none of the given `folder_names` appear in any existing
    66	 * registry entry. Optionally skips a specific entry by `excludeId` so that
    67	 * an update operation can keep its own existing folder names without conflict.
    68	 *
    69	 * @throws ApiError VALIDATION_ERROR listing the conflicting folder name(s).
    70	 */
    71	function assertNoFolderNameConflicts(
    72	  allEntries: RepositoryEntry[],
    73	  folderNames: string[],
    74	  excludeId?: string
    75	): void {
    76	  const conflicts: string[] = [];
    77	  for (const name of folderNames) {
    78	    const conflict = allEntries.find(
    79	      (e) => e.id !== excludeId && e.folder_names.includes(name)
    80	    );
    81	    if (conflict) {
    82	      conflicts.push(name);
    83	    }
    84	  }
    85	  if (conflicts.length > 0) {
    86	    validationError(
    87	      `folder_names conflict: the following names are already used by another repository entry: ${conflicts.map((n) => `'${n}'`).join(', ')}.`
    88	    );
    89	  }
    90	}

    93	// Zod schemas for request bodies
    94	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    96	/**
    97	 * Body schema for POST /api/repos.
    98	 *
    99	 * All fields required except `vision`, which defaults to all-null horizons

   144	  label: string;
   145	  folder_names: string[];

   147	  has_vision: boolean;

   156	    vision.mid_term !== null ||
   157	    vision.long_term !== null;

   159	    id: entry.id,
   160	    label: entry.label,
   161	    folder_names: entry.folder_names,
   162	    has_vision,
   163	    created_at: entry.created_at,
   164	    last_modified: entry.last_modified,
   165	  };
   166	}
   167	
   168	/**
   169	 * Lists all declared repositories from the registry file.
   170	 *
   171	 * Returns an empty array when the registry file does not exist yet (first-run).
   172	 *
   173	 * @param ledgerRoot - Absolute path to the centralized ledger root directory.
   174	 */
   175	export async function handleListRepos(ledgerRoot: string): Promise<RepoListItem[]> {
   176	  const registry = await loadRegistry(ledgerRoot);
   177	  return registry.repositories.map(toListItem);
   178	}
   179

   181	// GET /api/repos/:repoId
   182	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   183	
   184	/**
   185	 * Returns the full repository entry for the given `repoId`, or throws
   186	 * NOT_FOUND (404) if no entry with that id exists in the registry.
   187	 *
   188	 * @param ledgerRoot - Absolute path to the centralized ledger root directory.
   189	 * @param repoId     - The `id` field of the repository entry to retrieve.
   190	 */
   191	export async function handleGetRepo(
   192	  ledgerRoot: string,
   193	  repoId: string
   194	): Promise<RepositoryEntry> {
   195	  const registry = await loadRegistry(ledgerRoot);
   196	  const entry = registry.repositories.find((e) => e.id === repoId);
   197	  if (!entry) {
   198	    throw new ApiError('NOT_FOUND', `Repository not found: '${repoId}'.`);
   199	  }
   200	  return entry;
   201	}
   202	
   203	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   204	// POST /api/repos
   205	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   206	
   207	/**
   208	 * Creates a new repository entry in the registry.
   209	 *
   210	 * Validations (in order):
   211	 *   1. Request body must conform to {@link RepoCreateBodySchema}.
   212	 *   2. `id` must match SLUG_REGEX (enforced by the schema).
   213	 *   3. `id` must be unique (no existing entry with the same id).
   214	 *   4. No `folder_names` value may already appear in any existing entry.
   215	 *
   216	 * On success, returns the newly created {@link RepositoryEntry}.
   217	 *
   218	 * @param ledgerRoot - Absolute path to the centralized ledger root directory.
   219	 * @param body       - Parsed request body (any shape — validated here).
   220	 */
   221	export async function handleCreateRepo(
   222	  ledgerRoot: string,
   223	  body: unknown
   224	): Promise<RepositoryEntry> {
   225	  const parsed = RepoCreateBodySchema.safeParse(body);
   226	  if (!parsed.success) {
   227	    validationError(
   228	      'Invalid request body.',
   229	      parsed.error.flatten().fieldErrors
   230	    );
   231	  }
   232	
   233	  const { id, label, folder_names, vision } = parsed.data;
   234	  const registry = await loadRegistry(ledgerRoot);
   235	
   236	  // Unique id check
